resources.string: One silent line after each surprise toot

string-array.name: news_loud
string-array.item: %1$s: yep, that was loud. Check your title.

string-array.name: news_soft

string-array.name: nag_frozen
string-array.item: %1$s: when do I get out? Waiting %2$d hours now

string-array.item: %1$s: chicken hours, so holding it… really holding it…
